models.tenantBranding: The tenant's sign-in page branding: identity, colors, welcome text, notice, support contact, and links, as saved in the Branding admin pages.
models.signInState: The reason banner shown at the top of the sign-in card, if any.
models.breakGlassAdmin: The break-glass administrator account state that drives the admin door steps and the rate-limit refusal.
models.tenantSettings: The tenant settings that change the sign-in page: local accounts and the idle timeout.
models.setupSteps: Progress of the `genie-ops setup` steps (`setup_step` in architecture/data-shape.md). Until all are done every route renders the not-set-up page and the health endpoint reports degraded.

relationships: tenantBranding belongs to the one tenant this deployment serves and is read by every auth page; the app never inspects the hostname
signInState is one of several variants of the same sign-in page
breakGlassAdmin belongs to one tenant and has no relation to members; mustChangePassword and mustEnrollAuthenticator decide the door steps and gate the limited-session page
setupSteps are written by the operator CLI, not by the app; the not-set-up page only reads them
